binary_layout: Existing Titan live snapshot/event/timing version 1, unchanged byte offsets. This schema supplies profile-specific semantics; the schema SHA-256 must match before decoding.
spectrum_values: Native donor spectrogram magnitudes, not K1 magnitudes and not interpolated bins.
chroma_values: Unrotated donor get_chromagram output: spectrogram_smooth bins 0..59 folded modulo 12 and normalized by the donor. Bin 0 corresponds to 77.78175 Hz (D#/Eb2).
palette_semantics: ID 0 is a transport placeholder. The donor owns colour; no Titan palette catalogue is applied.
deadline_semantics: Nominal 5 ms audio period. AP/VP cycles and measured hop intervals are observations, not a claimed target deadline admission. publication_deadline_misses counts transitions into stale publication, not every AP execution exceeding 5 ms.
render_schedule: 100 Hz is the declared port schedule, not a recovered historical donor frame rate.

disabled_config.reason: Superseded 2026-09-29. Legacy K1 subcommands 1 through 12 remain rejected. Donor GET 0x454D0101 and masked PATCH 0x454D0102 are the control surface. Bind this schema file to the INFO schema hash.
disabled_config.superseded_reason: Legacy K1 focus/performance/PATCH/config/schema commands do not control this donor.

color.note: Explicit write replaces the auto-color phase. Readback color may exceed 1 while auto-color is evolving. effective_hue is the fractional part and is not written back.

speed.applicable_when: current_mode == Analog (0). Stored but ineffective in other modes, including this donor Bloom variant.

saturation.wire: native raw. Host UI uses one sqrt transform.

values.0: reference: donor post-gamma floats, temporal-dithered RGB8, x257 on the wire
values.1: candidate: the same validated floats rounded to 16 bits (v*65535+0.5), no dither

output_precision.note: Same nearest 128->160 mapping and one output gain in both. Boot and reboot return 0.

values.1..44: K1 product palette id-1, sampled at the donor hue phase; donor saturation and value applied

palette.note: Applies to every donor mode through hsv(); background colour computed in leds.h stays native. Boot returns 0.

output_intensity_a.note: Physical DIN-A logical pixels 0..79 only; shared scene and music motion remain unchanged. Cached Q16 gain rounded from value*65535, applied after hardware scale16 as (component*q16+32767)/65535; 1.0 is byte exact.

output_intensity_b.note: Physical DIN-B logical pixels 80..159 only; same independent output gain law as DIN-A. Boot defaults to 1.0; a patch to one lane preserves the other.

statuses.reconcile_versus_timeout: Owner reconcile status 9 includes the 160-byte state. Transport timeout status 9 has an empty body.

mode_control.owner: Queued through the existing idle RT owner; response follows application or rejection.
mode_control.scope: Selects one complete donor scene. Both mode fields must agree. Brightness is the final hardware gain; it does not modify donor brightness.
mode_control.unavailable: Version 2/3 transition/travel controls, automatic palette cycling, independent scenes and legacy performance scalars. Physical A/B intensity uses donor_control fields 19/20.

brightness_authority: Normal boot/default brightness is at least 100/255. Explicit operator dimming/off remains available.

snapshot_field_semantics.valid: 64 fresh chunks since boot or the latest audio gap. Host/control/render activity does not establish valid audio.
snapshot_field_semantics.capture_time_us: DMA-based capture estimate transformed into the live clock; includes declared ASRC filter delay. No physical acoustic timestamp claim.
snapshot_field_semantics.publish_time_us: Actual donor AP completion timestamp in the live clock.
snapshot_field_semantics.analysis_end_exclusive: End sample index in the current 12.8 kHz stream epoch.
snapshot_field_semantics.peak_scaled: Maximum absolute normalized PCM sample in the latest accepted 64-sample chunk.
snapshot_field_semantics.vu_level: Native donor smoothed VU, not raw RMS.
snapshot_field_semantics.rms: RMS of the normalized input samples in the latest accepted chunk.
snapshot_field_semantics.crest: Latest chunk peak divided by latest chunk RMS, with a zero guard.
snapshot_field_semantics.spectrum: 64 native values followed by 16 zero slots.
snapshot_field_semantics.ap_cycles: Measured donor push and compact status-copy cost. Does not include raw capture or ASRC work.
snapshot_field_semantics.vp_cycles: Measured platform render slice, as supplied by the fixture.
snapshot_field_semantics.measured_hz: Measured raw capture source rate, not the 12.8 kHz analysis rate.
snapshot_field_semantics.event_mask: Always zero; retained event rows are per-hop observations, not detected attacks.
snapshot_field_semantics.legacy_request_receipts: PATCH/performance request receipts are unsupported because opcode 25 is disabled.
snapshot_field_semantics.zero_means_unsupported: Fields listed in unsupported_zero_fields must not be interpreted as negative detections or measured silence.

event_semantics.spectrum_peak_bin: Index 0..63 of the largest native donor spectrum magnitude. An all-zero frame may return 0; no confidence/validity claim.
event_semantics.chroma_peak: Index 0..11 in D#/Eb ordering. An all-zero frame may return 0; no pitch-lock claim.
event_semantics.musical_events: Unsupported legacy onset/beat/drum/saliency fields remain zero.

mir_json.donor_dominant_tempo_bpm: Largest donor tempo-bin candidate; not a locked or independently qualified beat estimate.
mir_json.donor_tempo_confidence: Native donor tempo statistic; not K1 confidence.

audio_gap_policy: Call the donor gap adapter once, clear PCM capture history, mark publication invalid and mute new AP deposits during 64 fresh chunks. Preserve existing VP/tempo/LPF/dither/configuration histories; do not initialize the engine again. Loss counters remain visible; this does not recover lost audio.

output.geometry: One continuous logical strip. DIN-A receives logical 0..79; DIN-B receives 80..159.
output.source_precision: Donor post-gamma, post-temporal-dither RGB8. Interpolation/16-bit packing does not create native donor colour precision.
output.adapter: Centre-symmetric spatial interpolation 128 to 160, expansion to 16-bit channels, one final global brightness/255 scaling, GRB48 packing.

note: AudioFeaturesV1 is an internal timestamp/VU carrier only. Legacy spectrum/chroma/onset validity flags are not asserted and the old K1 AP/VP does not drive this profile. Binary packet sizes stay compatible, semantics are selected by this schema identity. Host conformance does not establish target timing, uninterrupted capture or appearance acceptance.
